output.summary: An annual legume whose wild forms are native to Anatolia, northern Iraq and the Anti-Lebanon Mountains of Syria and Lebanon. Its split grain resembles red lentils, but the bitter seeds require leaching through several changes of boiling water before human consumption; historically, they were eaten mainly by poor people or during famine.
output.edibilityNote: Seeds require repeated changes of boiling water to remove bitterness; historically they were eaten mainly by poor people or during famine.
